extraction_method: web fetch of FedPayments Improvement page on Synthetic Identity Payments Fraud. Landing-page content is shallow; a Mitigation Toolkit with 3 white papers exists but is linked, not inlined.

synthetic_identity_definition.value: The use of a combination of personally identifiable information (PII) to fabricate a person or entity in order to commit a dishonest act for personal or financial gain.
synthetic_identity_definition.quote: The use of a combination of personally identifiable information (PII) to fabricate a person or entity in order to commit a dishonest act for personal or financial gain.

value.growth_trend: reported as the fastest-growing type of financial crime in the United States

mitigation_toolkit_reference.value: Federal Reserve released Synthetic Identity Fraud Mitigation Toolkit in early 2022 — online repository with three white papers on defining, detecting, and mitigating synthetic identity fraud, plus webinars and focus-group recommendations.

payments_industry_framing.value: Fed positions synthetic ID as a cross-industry problem — financial institutions, consumers, and businesses named as stakeholder groups. Not restricted to a specific sector.

suitable_for_grounding_fields: family_crisis_history (synthetic-ID-driven credit-file compromise events for ITIN holders)
persona_grounding_implications.behavioral_evidence_grade_when_used: B — regulatory source (Federal Reserve). Definition + mitigation-framework source, not a statistical deep-dive.
persona_grounding_implications.caveat: Landing-page content is thin. For specific numeric estimates (e.g., annual dollar losses, sector breakdown), the 3 linked white papers would need separate fetch/extraction. Present extraction has the framework but not the measurement detail.
